scope: Two new current national records and two material same-event refreshes; no historical correction.

changes.summary: BLS reported 29,000 September payroll growth, 4.2% unemployment and 60,000 in downward revisions.
changes.duplicate_review: Reviewed against dates, normalized titles, source URLs, current entries and recent maintenance releases; this was the new monthly employment measurement, not a duplicate policy action.

changes.summary: ICE issued trained-only vehicle-stop guidance, required lights, sirens and body cameras, and barred high-speed pursuits.
changes.duplicate_review: Promoted the preserved internal-guidance lead after direct Associated Press document review and an on-record ICE response; no existing canonical vehicle-stop policy record was found.

changes.summary: The G7 formally committed to a coordinated 100 million-barrel release with front-loaded diesel and no intra-G7 export restrictions.
changes.duplicate_review: The formal multilateral commitment advances the existing diesel-export-policy event and was not counted as a parallel event.

changes.summary: The Coast Guard disclosed its September 5 interception of a fuel vessel bound for Cuba.
changes.duplicate_review: The disclosed ship-level enforcement action advances the existing Cuba fuel-sanctions record and was not counted separately.
